CAMPUS CLASH 2D: WEBNEXUS

Official Project & Event Showcase Draft
HTML5 Canvas 2D • Web Audio API • 60 FPS Procedural • Zero External Dependencies

Introduction about the game

Campus Clash 2D: WebNexus Edition is an arcade-style, competitive 2D fighting game built specifically for college tech fests, hackathons, and esports arenas. Built entirely with 100% pure HTML5 Canvas and the Web Audio API, the game runs at a smooth 60 FPS directly inside modern web browsers with zero installations, downloads, or external image/audio asset requirements.

The game merges relatable campus student archetypes (Toppers, Backbenchers, Hostelers, Placement Warriors, Tech Hackers, etc.) with real-world emerging tech domains (Cloud Computing, Cyber Security, Internet of Things, and Edge Computing). Players duel across iconic SRM KTR campus locations and futuristic WebNexus tech arenas, collecting real-time falling "Nexus Modifiers" (Tech Pods) that transform real-world technology principles into exhilarating in-game battle buffs.

Objectives

  • Gamifying Core Tech Domains: Introduce students to fundamental tech concepts (Cloud system recovery, 4096-bit SSL encryption, IoT wireless telemetry, and Edge computing zero-latency overclocking) through real-time gameplay mechanics.
  • Competitive College Esports: Deliver a tournament-grade 2D fighting experience featuring combo scaling, counter-hit priorities, super-armor parries, and distinct visual/audio signatures for all characters.
  • 100% Lightweight & Zero Dependencies: Completely asset-free procedural architecture—loads instantly on any laptop, projector, or mobile device with zero lag.
  • Campus Culture Representation: Celebrate SRM KTR student culture, campus landmarks, and hackathon spirit in a fun, gamified format.

Event description

At the WebNexus Tech Fest / Hackathon, Campus Clash 2D serves as the central interactive showcase and esports event:

  • ☁️ Cloud Computing — The Cloud Citadel: Server blade racks, pulsating LED arrays, Kubernetes pod clusters, and real-time CPU/memory load tickers.
  • 🛡️ Cyber Security — Cyber Fortress Zero-Day: Dark matrix command hub, green binary rain waterfalls, honeycomb firewall barrier, and a live SEC_OPS threat HUD.
  • 📡 Internet of Things — IoT Sensor Matrix: PCB motherboard with glowing copper traces, ESP32/Raspberry Pi microcontrollers, and 2.4 GHz radio waves.
  • ⚡ Edge Computing — Edge Gateway Station: Decentralized edge node towers, cooling fan exhausts, optical laser channels, and 0.2ms zero-latency status tags.

In-Game "Nexus Modifiers" (Dynamic Tech Drops)

  • Cloud Backup (Cloud): Restores +25 HP to the player (System Rollback & Data Recovery).
  • SSL Encryption (CyberSec): Grants a 5-second 4096-Bit Super Armor Shield (-40% damage taken).
  • Edge Overclock (Edge): Grants +35% movement speed and +20 Ultimate Meter (Zero-Latency Mode).
  • IoT 2.4GHz EMP (IoT): Drains 25 Ultimate Meter from the opponent and inflicts a glitch stun.

How will it be played players sab info

Game Modes: 1v1 Local Versus (two players on one keyboard/gamepad), VS AI Mode (4 bot difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard, Pro), and Training Dojo (programmable dummy actions and frame data).
